document.abstract: Since at least the 19th century, if not earlier, people have tried to improve such characteristics of motion imaging as spatial resolution, aspect ratio, frame rate, dynamic range, and color gamut. Many of those improvements have affected other characteristics. There is no indication that improvements will soon stop.
